_readme: CardSpoke plugin package template. Copy this file, fill in the fields, then install it via Plugin Manager -> Install (or Plugin.install(pkg)).
The `js` string is your setup code: it runs, inside your own sandboxed Worker, as the BODY of an async function receiving `ctx` whenever the plugin is enabled. Do NOT call registerPlugin from it.
There is no DOM/window/fetch/localStorage in that worker. Build UI with ctx.h(tag, props, children) instead of document.createElement; every ctx.api.* call is async — use await.
Everything you create through ctx.api.* (DOM injections, components, middleware, event listeners) is tracked and cleaned up automatically when the plugin is suspended or removed.
`teardownJs` is optional extra cleanup for things the tracker cannot see (setInterval, ...). It receives the same ctx object as setup.
layer: 'theme' = CSS only (auto-enabled) | 'feature' = CSS+JS (auto-enabled unless it declares overrides) | 'app' = deep transformation (user must enable it manually).

permissions your js needs: 'ui-override' (ctx.api.ui.inject/replace/registerComponent), 'data-modify' (create/update/delete cards, tags), 'storage' (ctx.api.storage), 'network' (ctx.api.network), 'filesystem' (ctx.api.filesystem). The user is asked for consent on first enable, and the sandbox enforces it — a denied permission is not reachable, not just discouraged.
Full documentation: docs/architecture/PLUGIN_SYSTEM.md. Hard constraints: docs/architecture/PLUGIN_INVARIANTS.md.
css: /* Optional. Injected while the plugin is enabled, removed when suspended. */
teardownJs: // Optional. Extra cleanup for timers; tracked resources are removed automatically.
